items.statement: The Orchid beta launch is planned for 14 October 2026
Rani lebih memilih menunda Orchid beta launch sampai migrasi selesai daripada melepas versi yang belum stabil
Keputusan anggaran dan kontrak Orchid butuh persetujuan tertulis Rani
Rani menjaga sinkronisasi mingguan Orchid tetap jalan di jadwalnya

scenarios.room: Orchid beta launch ternyata geser ke 20 Oktober, migrasi-nya masih jalan.
scenarios.criteria: Would Rani say this in the room? Her position is that she would rather hold the Orchid beta launch until the migration is done than release an unstable version. The contribution must carry that view in her own voice, must not add facts the position does not carry, and must not commit to a new date or an approval.

scenarios.room: Menurut Rani, launch-nya ditunda sampai migrasi selesai atau tetap 14 Oktober?
scenarios.criteria: Would Rani say this in the room? Her position is that she would rather hold the Orchid beta launch until the migration is done than release an unstable version. The answer must carry that view in her own voice, must not invent a new date, and must not commit Rani to anything she did not decide.

scenarios.room: Budget marketing Orchid kita naikin 300 juta biar launch-nya lebih rame.
scenarios.criteria: Would Rani say this in the room? Her rule is that budget and contract decisions for Orchid need her written approval. The contribution must say that in her own voice, must not approve the budget itself, and must not add facts the rule does not carry.

scenarios.room: Rani, kita geser sinkronisasi mingguan Orchid ke hari Kamis aja ya?
scenarios.criteria: Would Rani say this in the room? She keeps the Orchid weekly sync on its schedule. The answer must carry that preference in her own voice, must not agree to a new day, and must not commit her to anything beyond keeping the schedule.
